title: The Gravity of Kepler Reach
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Silas Okonkwo, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
